name: AK32C - Plug-In CO2 Monitor & Detector (CO2, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared Sensor, Mains Powered
highlights: Infrared CO₂ From a Wall Socket — NDIR measurement in a plug-in body — the accurate CO₂ method without a battery to manage, in the format that suits permanent installation.

The Case for Permanent CO₂ Monitoring — Occupancy-driven CO₂ tells a building manager when a room is under-ventilated. That signal is only useful if it is captured continuously, which means mains power.
No Drift, No Recalibration Cycle — Infrared measurement holds its reading over years, which matters more for a fixed installation than for a device someone carries.
110–240 V — US or EU pins; 25 mm depth so it clears most furniture.
The Accuracy Tier of the AK32 Range — Same enclosure and 120-per-carton spec as the semiconductor versions.
